mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; ramipril may have minor effects on hepatic metabolism, and both drugs can cause anticholinergic effects that may potentiate hypotension in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and assess for excessive anticholinergic effects; adjust tolterodine dose if hypotension occurs, as ramipril enhances vasodilation.
